title: Cadence
subtitle: Light that answers every turn of the head.
description: A pair of earrings built for motion. Round brilliants are set in eighteen-karat white gold so that light returns with every movement — a quiet, continuous rhythm rather than a single fixed sparkle. Earrings are the only jewellery that moves with the face, and these were designed around that fact: the stones catch, release, and catch again as the head turns, keeping light at the jawline through a whole evening. Clean, unfussy, made to be worn often and to flatter constantly.
